source.heading: Source

pending.notIncluded: but the active snapshot does not include it yet: the site still shows the previous version.
pending.stillShown: but the active snapshot still shows it: the site goes back to the Git text with the next publication.

notice.published: Revision #{id} published. The site will show it once you publish the documentation.
notice.archivedPublished: Revision #{id} archived. The next publication shows Git again.
notice.exported: Downloaded {filename} with revision #{id}. Copy it to {file} to bring it to the repository.
notice.merged: Draft #{id} created with the current Git and the changes of revision #{revision}.

facts.meekoFile: .meeko page: its text lives in the repository

noRevisions.editable: No revisions: the site publishes the file in Git. Edit the source to create the first draft.
noRevisions.gone: No revisions. Git no longer has this file, so it cannot be edited.
noRevisions.meeko: .meeko pages have no revisions: they change in the repository.

source.revisionsCaption: Revisions of the source, newest first

badges.archivedAfter: Archived after the active snapshot, which still shows it: the site goes back to Git with the next publication.
badges.publishedAfter: Published after the active snapshot: the site does not show it yet.
badges.conflictHelp: Git changed after it was written: its base is not the file of now.

conflict.title: Conflict of revision #{id} with Git
conflict.missing: Git no longer has this file.
conflict.lead: The revision was written over a version of Git ({base}, found in {origin}) that is not the current one ({git}).
conflict.noBase: The Git text it was written over cannot be found ({base}): only the current Git and the revision are compared, without a merge.
conflict.trivialText: Git and the revision changed different parts: you can create a new draft with the current Git and the changes of the revision, and review it before publishing.
conflict.manual: There is no automatic merge: edit a draft by hand from Git or from the revision.
conflict.merge: Create draft: current Git + my changes
conflict.baseGitHint: What changed in Git since the revision was written.
conflict.baseGitLabel: Diff from the base to the current Git
conflict.baseRevisionLabel: Diff from the base to the revision
conflict.gitRevisionHint: What the site will show if the revision is published as is.
conflict.gitRevisionLabel: Diff from the current Git to the revision
conflict.noBaseDiff: No base: it cannot be shown.

compare.title: Compare
compare.label: Compare two versions
compare.tooLarge: The texts are too different to compare line by line.

gitDiff.title: Diff with Git
gitDiff.label: Unified diff from Git to the published revision
gitDiff.none: No published revision: the site shows exactly Git.

confirm.publishText: It becomes the published text of this source and archives the previous published one. The site shows it from the next publication of the documentation.
confirm.archivePublishedText: It stops being the published text: the next publication of the documentation shows Git again.
confirm.archiveText: It stays in the history and can no longer be edited; you can start a new draft from it.
confirm.conflictWarning: This revision was written over another version of Git: publishing it discards what changed in Git since then. Review the conflict first.
